A personal view of your investments

Your investments,
in one clear view.

A self-hosted portfolio tracker for stocks, crypto and Mexican fixed income. Understand your holdings, cost basis and currency effects across MXN and USD.

Explore the project ↗ Run your instance

Open source · Single user · MXN / USD

Know what you own.
Understand what changed.

Built for a personal portfolio, with the Mexican market in mind. Stockerly describes what it observes, so you can read the numbers in their context.

01

Holdings without guesswork

Record trades or review a CSV import. Bring stocks, crypto and CETES together with their original currencies and cost basis.

02

Returns with context

Read portfolio history and unrealized results. Where available, separate asset movement from the effect of MXN / USD conversion.

03

A tool you can run yourself

One account, created at first setup. Configure optional data providers and keep the application on your own infrastructure.

Missing data should look like missing data.

An unavailable quote is shown as unavailable. A value of zero means zero. Dates, currencies and sources make the difference visible.

— Quote unavailable

Lumen / Brand identity

One candle.
A clear point of view.

A rounded market candle, drawn with one continuous line. It connects Stockerly to the language of markets without promising a direction, a trade or a result.

Works in one color

The lettering is outlined SVG geometry. The logo stays intact without installed fonts.

A calm, specific voice.

Describe observations. Name currencies, dates and periods. Say when information is missing. Avoid investment advice, guarantees and manufactured social proof.

“Unrealized result · +14,800.00 MXN”

“Quote unavailable · last update shown when known”
